description: This dataset contains observations of the orchid species Pterostylis graminea, collected from various locations in New Zealand. The data includes taxonomic information such as kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species, as well as location details like country code, state/province, and coordinates. Each observation is recorded with a unique identifier, and additional metadata includes the observer's name, date of observation, and licensing information. The semantic profile of the dataset indicates that it is well-structured for biodiversity research, with clear classification and aggregation keys for taxonomic and spatial data. This dataset can be used for studying the distribution and habitat preferences of Pterostylis graminea, as well as for broader ecological and conservation research on orchid species in New Zealand. The observations span from 2018 to 2025, providing a temporal overview of the species' presence in different regions.
